description: This file defines the TemplateWrapper class in the Twig templating engine, providing methods to interact with and render templates.

classes.name: TemplateWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps around a Twig Template object to provide rendering and block management functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateWrapper with an Environment and Template instance.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Streams the template output as an iterable.

methods.name: streamBlock
methods.description: Streams a specific block of the template as an iterable.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template to a string based on the provided context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template with the provided context, internally calling the template's display method.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists within the template.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all block names defined in the template.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a specific block with the given context.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Displays a specific block, outputting its data directly.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context of the template.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the underlying Template object; internal use only.
